statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s → ∀ {f : Filter X} [f.NeBot], f ≤ Filter.principal s → ∃ x ∈ s, ClusterPt x f

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {ι : Type u_2},
  IsCompact s →
    ∀ {f : Filter ι} [f.NeBot] {u : ι → X}, Filter.map u f ≤ Filter.principal s → ∃ x ∈ s, MapClusterPt x f u

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {l : Filter X},
  IsCompact s → (∃ᶠ (x : X) in l, x ∈ s) → ∃ a ∈ s, ClusterPt a l

∀ {X : Type u} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {l : Filter ι} {f : ι → X},
  IsCompact s → (∃ᶠ (x : ι) in l, f x ∈ s) → ∃ a ∈ s, MapClusterPt a l f

doc:
The complement to a compact set belongs to a filter `f` if it belongs to each filter
`𝓝 x ⊓ f`, `x ∈ s`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s → ∀ {f : Filter X}, (∀ x ∈ s, sᶜ ∈ nhds x ⊓ f) → sᶜ ∈ f

doc:
The complement to a compact set belongs to a filter `f` if each `x ∈ s` has a neighborhood `t`
within `s` such that `tᶜ` belongs to `f`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s → ∀ {f : Filter X}, (∀ x ∈ s, ∃ t ∈ nhdsWithin x s, tᶜ ∈ f) → sᶜ ∈ f

doc:
If `p : Set X → Prop` is stable under restriction and union, and each point `x`
of a compact set `s` has a neighborhood `t` within `s` such that `p t`, then `p s` holds.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s →
    ∀ {p : Set X → Prop},
      p ∅ →
        (∀ ⦃s t : Set X⦄, s ⊆ t → p t → p s) →
          (∀ ⦃s t : Set X⦄, p s → p t → p (s ∪ t)) → (∀ x ∈ s, ∃ t ∈ nhdsWithin x s, p t) → p s

doc: The intersection of a compact set and a closed set is a compact set.
statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s t : Set X}, IsCompact s → IsClosed t → IsCompact (s ∩ t)

doc: The intersection of a closed set and a compact set is a compact set.
statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s t : Set X}, IsCompact t → IsClosed s → IsCompact (s ∩ t)

doc: The set difference of a compact set and an open set is a compact set.
statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s t : Set X}, IsCompact s → IsOpen t → IsCompact (s \ t)

doc: A closed subset of a compact set is a compact set.
statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s t : Set X}, IsCompact s → IsClosed t → t ⊆ s → IsCompact t

∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set X} {f : X → Y},
  IsCompact s → ContinuousOn f s → IsCompact (f '' s)

∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set X} {f : X → Y},
  IsCompact s → Continuous f → IsCompact (f '' s)

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s t : Set X} {f : Filter X},
  IsCompact s → f ≤ Filter.principal s → IsOpen t → (∀ x ∈ s, ClusterPt x f → x ∈ t) → t ∈ f

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s ↔ ∀ (f : Ultrafilter X), ↑f ≤ Filter.principal s → ∃ x ∈ s, ↑f ≤ nhds x

doc: **Alias** of the forward direction of `isCompact_iff_ultrafilter_le_nhds`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s → ∀ (f : Ultrafilter X), ↑f ≤ Filter.principal s → ∃ x ∈ s, ↑f ≤ nhds x

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s ↔ ∀ (f : Ultrafilter X), s ∈ f → ∃ x ∈ s, ↑f ≤ nhds x

doc: **Alias** of the forward direction of `isCompact_iff_ultrafilter_le_nhds'`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s → ∀ (f : Ultrafilter X), s ∈ f → ∃ x ∈ s, ↑f ≤ nhds x

doc:
If a compact set belongs to a filter and all cluster points in this set and in the filter
lie in a set `s'` then the filter is less than or equal to `𝓝ˢ s'`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s → ∀ {l : Filter X} {s' : Set X}, s ∈ l → (∀ x ∈ s, ClusterPt x l → x ∈ s') → l ≤ nhdsSet s'

doc:
If a compact set belongs to a filter and this filter has a unique cluster point `y` in this set,
then the filter is less than or equal to `𝓝 y`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s → ∀ {l : Filter X} {y : X}, s ∈ l → (∀ x ∈ s, ClusterPt x l → x = y) → l ≤ nhds y

doc:
If values of `f : Y → X` belong to a compact set `s` eventually along a filter `l`
and `s'` is the set of `MapClusterPt` for `f` along `l` in `s`,
then `f` tends to `𝓝ˢ s'` along `l`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {Y : Type u_2} {l : Filter Y} {s' : Set X} {f : Y → X},
  IsCompact s → (∀ᶠ (x : Y) in l, f x ∈ s) → (∀ x ∈ s, MapClusterPt x l f → x ∈ s') → Filter.Tendsto f l (nhdsSet s')

doc:
If values of `f : Y → X` belong to a compact set `s` eventually along a filter `l`
and `y` is a unique `MapClusterPt` for `f` along `l` in `s`,
then `f` tends to `𝓝 y` along `l`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {Y : Type u_2} {l : Filter Y} {y : X} {f : Y → X},
  IsCompact s → (∀ᶠ (x : Y) in l, f x ∈ s) → (∀ x ∈ s, MapClusterPt x l f → x = y) → Filter.Tendsto f l (nhds y)

doc:
For every open directed cover of a compact set, there exists a single element of the
cover which itself includes the set.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {ι : Type v} [hι : Nonempty ι],
  IsCompact s →
    ∀ (U : ι → Set X), (∀ (i : ι), IsOpen (U i)) → s ⊆ ⋃ i, U i → Directed (fun x1 x2 => x1 ⊆ x2) U → ∃ i, s ⊆ U i

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s →
    ∀ (U : Set (Set X)),
      (∀ u ∈ U, IsOpen u) → s ⊆ ⋃₀ U → DirectedOn (fun x1 x2 => x1 ⊆ x2) U → U.Nonempty → ∃ u ∈ U, s ⊆ u

doc: For every open cover of a compact set, there exists a finite subcover.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {ι : Type v},
  IsCompact s → ∀ (U : ι → Set X), (∀ (i : ι), IsOpen (U i)) → s ⊆ ⋃ i, U i → ∃ t, s ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ t, U i

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s →
    ∀ (U : (x : X) → x ∈ s → Set X), (∀ (x : X) (hx : x ∈ s), U x hx ∈ nhds x) → ∃ t, ⋃ x ∈ t, U ↑x ⋯ ∈ nhdsSet s

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s → ∀ {U : X → Set X}, (∀ x ∈ s, U x ∈ nhds x) → ∃ t, (∀ x ∈ t, x ∈ s) ∧ ⋃ x ∈ t, U x ∈ nhdsSet s

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s → ∀ (U : (x : X) → x ∈ s → Set X), (∀ (x : X) (hx : x ∈ s), U x hx ∈ nhds x) → ∃ t, s ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ t, U ↑x ⋯

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s → ∀ (U : X → Set X), (∀ x ∈ s, U x ∈ nhds x) → ∃ t, (∀ x ∈ t, x ∈ s) ∧ s ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ t, U x

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s →
    ∀ (U : (x : X) → x ∈ s → Set X), (∀ (x : X) (hx : x ∈ s), U x hx ∈ nhdsWithin x s) → ∃ t, s ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ t, U ↑x ⋯

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s → ∀ (U : X → Set X), (∀ x ∈ s, U x ∈ nhdsWithin x s) → ∃ t, (∀ x ∈ t, x ∈ s) ∧ s ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ t, U x

doc:
The neighborhood filter of a compact set is disjoint with a filter `l` if and only if the
neighborhood filter of each point of this set is disjoint with `l`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {l : Filter X},
  IsCompact s → (Disjoint (nhdsSet s) l ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, Disjoint (nhds x) l)

doc:
A filter `l` is disjoint with the neighborhood filter of a compact set if and only if it is
disjoint with the neighborhood filter of each point of this set.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {l : Filter X},
  IsCompact s → (Disjoint l (nhdsSet s) ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, Disjoint l (nhds x))

doc:
For every directed family of closed sets whose intersection is disjoint from a compact set,
there exists a single element of the family which itself is disjoint from this compact set.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {ι : Type v} [Nonempty ι],
  IsCompact s →
    ∀ (t : ι → Set X),
      (∀ (i : ι), IsClosed (t i)) → Disjoint s (⋂ i, t i) → Directed (fun x1 x2 => x1 ⊇ x2) t → ∃ i, Disjoint s (t i)

doc:
For every family of closed sets whose intersection is disjoint from a compact set,
there exists a finite subfamily whose intersection is disjoint from this compact set.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {ι : Type v},
  IsCompact s → ∀ (t : ι → Set X), (∀ (i : ι), IsClosed (t i)) → Disjoint s (⋂ i, t i) → ∃ u, Disjoint s (⋂ i ∈ u, t i)

doc:
To show that a compact set intersects the intersection of a family of closed sets,
it is sufficient to show that it intersects every finite subfamily.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {ι : Type v},
  IsCompact s →
    ∀ (t : ι → Set X),
      (∀ (i : ι), IsClosed (t i)) → (∀ (u : Finset ι), (s ∩ ⋂ i ∈ u, t i).Nonempty) → (s ∩ ⋂ i, t i).Nonempty

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s →
    ∀ {t : Set (Set X)}, (∀ a ∈ t, IsClosed a) → (∀ a ⊆ t, a.Finite → (s ∩ ⋂₀ a).Nonempty) → (s ∩ ⋂₀ t).Nonempty

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {s : Set (Set X)},
  (∀ t ∈ s, IsClosed t) → (∀ t ⊆ s, t.Finite → (⋂₀ t).Nonempty) → (⋂₀ s).Nonempty

doc:
Cantor's intersection theorem for `iInter`:
the intersection of a directed family of nonempty compact closed sets is nonempty.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {ι : Type v} [hι : Nonempty ι] (t : ι → Set X),
  Directed (fun x1 x2 => x1 ⊇ x2) t →
    (∀ (i : ι), (t i).Nonempty) → (∀ (i : ι), IsCompact (t i)) → (∀ (i : ι), IsClosed (t i)) → (⋂ i, t i).Nonempty

doc:
Cantor's intersection theorem for `sInter`:
the intersection of a directed family of nonempty compact closed sets is nonempty.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set (Set X)} [hS : Nonempty ↑S],
  DirectedOn (fun x1 x2 => x1 ⊇ x2) S →
    (∀ U ∈ S, U.Nonempty) → (∀ U ∈ S, IsCompact U) → (∀ U ∈ S, IsClosed U) → (⋂₀ S).Nonempty

doc:
Cantor's intersection theorem for sequences indexed by `ℕ`:
the intersection of a decreasing sequence of nonempty compact closed sets is nonempty.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] (t : ℕ → Set X),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), t (i + 1) ⊆ t i) →
    (∀ (i : ℕ), (t i).Nonempty) → IsCompact (t 0) → (∀ (i : ℕ), IsClosed (t i)) → (⋂ i, t i).Nonempty

doc: For every open cover of a compact set, there exists a finite subcover.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {b : Set ι} {c : ι → Set X},
  IsCompact s → (∀ i ∈ b, IsOpen (c i)) → s ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ b, c i → ∃ b' ⊆ b, b'.Finite ∧ s ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ b', c i

doc: A set `s` is compact if for every open cover of `s`, there exists a finite subcover.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  (∀ {ι : Type u} (U : ι → Set X), (∀ (i : ι), IsOpen (U i)) → s ⊆ ⋃ i, U i → ∃ t, s ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ t, U i) → IsCompact s

doc:
A set `s` is compact if for every family of closed sets whose intersection is disjoint from `s`,
there exists a finite subfamily whose intersection is disjoint from `s`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  (∀ {ι : Type u} (t : ι → Set X),
      (∀ (i : ι), IsClosed (t i)) → Disjoint s (⋂ i, t i) → ∃ u, Disjoint s (⋂ i ∈ u, t i)) →
    IsCompact s

doc:
A set `s` is compact if and only if
for every open cover of `s`, there exists a finite subcover.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s ↔ ∀ {ι : Type u} (U : ι → Set X), (∀ (i : ι), IsOpen (U i)) → s ⊆ ⋃ i, U i → ∃ t, s ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ t, U i

doc:
A set `s` is compact if and only if for every family of closed sets whose intersection is
disjoint from `s`, there exists a finite subfamily whose intersection is disjoint from `s`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s ↔
    ∀ {ι : Type u} (t : ι → Set X), (∀ (i : ι), IsClosed (t i)) → Disjoint s (⋂ i, t i) → ∃ u, Disjoint s (⋂ i ∈ u, t i)

doc:
If `s : Set (X × Y)` belongs to `𝓝 x ×ˢ l` for all `x` from a compact set `K`,
then it belongs to `(𝓝ˢ K) ×ˢ l`,
i.e., there exist an open `U ⊇ K` and `t ∈ l` such that `U ×ˢ t ⊆ s`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {K : Set X} {Y : Type u_2} {l : Filter Y} {s : Set (X × Y)},
  IsCompact K → (∀ x ∈ K, s ∈ nhds x ×ˢ l) → s ∈ nhdsSet K ×ˢ l

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {K : Set X},
  IsCompact K → ∀ {Y : Type u_2} (l : Filter Y), nhdsSet K ×ˢ l = ⨆ x ∈ K, nhds x ×ˢ l

∀ {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace Y] {K : Set Y},
  IsCompact K → ∀ {X : Type u_2} (l : Filter X), l ×ˢ nhdsSet K = ⨆ y ∈ K, l ×ˢ nhds y

doc:
If `s : Set (X × Y)` belongs to `l ×ˢ 𝓝 y` for all `y` from a compact set `K`,
then it belongs to `l ×ˢ (𝓝ˢ K)`,
i.e., there exist `t ∈ l` and an open `U ⊇ K` such that `t ×ˢ U ⊆ s`.
statement:
∀ {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace Y] {K : Set Y} {X : Type u_2} {l : Filter X} {s : Set (X × Y)},
  IsCompact K → (∀ y ∈ K, s ∈ l ×ˢ nhds y) → s ∈ l ×ˢ nhdsSet K

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {K : Set X},
  IsCompact K → ∀ (l : Filter X), nhdsSet K ⊓ l = ⨆ x ∈ K, nhds x ⊓ l

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {K : Set X},
  IsCompact K → ∀ (l : Filter X), l ⊓ nhdsSet K = ⨆ x ∈ K, l ⊓ nhds x

doc:
If `s : Set X` belongs to `𝓝 x ⊓ l` for all `x` from a compact set `K`,
then it belongs to `(𝓝ˢ K) ⊓ l`,
i.e., there exist an open `U ⊇ K` and `T ∈ l` such that `U ∩ T ⊆ s`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {K : Set X} {l : Filter X} {s : Set X},
  IsCompact K → (∀ x ∈ K, s ∈ nhds x ⊓ l) → s ∈ nhdsSet K ⊓ l

doc:
If `s : Set S` belongs to `l ⊓ 𝓝 x` for all `x` from a compact set `K`,
then it belongs to `l ⊓ (𝓝ˢ K)`,
i.e., there exist `T ∈ l` and an open `U ⊇ K` such that `T ∩ U ⊆ s`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {K : Set X} {l : Filter X} {s : Set X},
  IsCompact K → (∀ y ∈ K, s ∈ l ⊓ nhds y) → s ∈ l ⊓ nhdsSet K

doc:
To show that `∀ y ∈ K, P x y` holds for `x` close enough to `x₀` when `K` is compact,
it is sufficient to show that for all `y₀ ∈ K` there `P x y` holds for `(x, y)` close enough
to `(x₀, y₀)`.

Provided for backwards compatibility,
see `IsCompact.mem_prod_nhdsSet_of_forall` for a stronger statement.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {x₀ : X} {K : Set Y},
  IsCompact K →
    ∀ {P : X → Y → Prop}, (∀ y ∈ K, ∀ᶠ (z : X × Y) in nhds (x₀, y), P z.1 z.2) → ∀ᶠ (x : X) in nhds x₀, ∀ y ∈ K, P x y
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], IsCompact ∅
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {x : X}, IsCompact {x}
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X}, s.Subsingleton → IsCompact s

∀ {X : Type u} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set ι} {f : ι → Set X},
  s.Finite → (∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (f i)) → IsCompact (⋃ i ∈ s, f i)

∀ {X : Type u} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → Set X},
  (∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (f i)) → IsCompact (⋃ i ∈ s, f i)

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {K : ℕ → Set X},
  (∀ (n : ℕ), IsCompact (K n)) → ∀ (n : ℕ), IsCompact (Set.accumulate K n)
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set (Set X)}, S.Finite → (∀ s ∈ S, IsCompact s) → IsCompact (⋃₀ S)

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {ι : Sort u_2} {f : ι → Set X} [Finite ι],
  (∀ (i : ι), IsCompact (f i)) → IsCompact (⋃ i, f i)
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X}, s.Finite → IsCompact s
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], ⋃₀ {s | IsCompact s} = Set.univ
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} [DiscreteTopology X], IsCompact s → s.Finite
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} [DiscreteTopology X], IsCompact s ↔ s.Finite
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s t : Set X}, IsCompact s → IsCompact t → IsCompact (s ∪ t)
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X}, IsCompact s → ∀ (a : X), IsCompact (insert a s)

doc:
If `V : ι → Set X` is a decreasing family of closed compact sets then any neighborhood of
`⋂ i, V i` contains some `V i`. We assume each `V i` is compact *and* closed because `X` is
not assumed to be Hausdorff. See `exists_subset_nhds_of_isCompact` for a version assuming this.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [Nonempty ι] {V : ι → Set X},
  Directed (fun x1 x2 => x1 ⊇ x2) V →
    (∀ (i : ι), IsCompact (V i)) → (∀ (i : ι), IsClosed (V i)) → ∀ {U : Set X}, U ∈ nhdsSet (⋂ i, V i) → ∃ i, V i ⊆ U

doc:
**Alexander's subbasis theorem**. Suppose `X` is a topological space with a subbasis `S` and `s` is
a subset of `X`. Then `s` is compact if for any open cover of `s` with all elements taken from `S`,
there is a finite subcover.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [T : TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set (Set X)},
  T = TopologicalSpace.generateFrom S → ∀ {s : Set X}, (∀ P ⊆ S, s ⊆ ⋃₀ P → ∃ Q ⊆ P, Q.Finite ∧ s ⊆ ⋃₀ Q) → IsCompact s

∀ {X : Type u} [T : TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set (Set X)},
  T = TopologicalSpace.generateFrom S →
    ∀ {s : Set X}, (∀ (ι : Type u) (U : ι → ↑S), s ⊆ ⋃ i, ↑(U i) → ∃ J, J.Finite ∧ s ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ J, ↑(U i)) → IsCompact s
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], (Filter.cocompact X).HasBasis IsCompact compl
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X}, s ∈ Filter.cocompact X ↔ ∃ t, IsCompact t ∧ tᶜ ⊆ s
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X}, s ∈ Filter.cocompact X ↔ ∃ t, IsCompact t ∧ sᶜ ⊆ t
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X}, IsCompact s → sᶜ ∈ Filter.cocompact X
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], Filter.cocompact X ≤ Filter.cofinite
∀ (X : Type u_2) [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [DiscreteTopology X], Filter.cocompact X = Filter.cofinite

doc: A filter is disjoint from the cocompact filter if and only if it contains a compact set.
statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] (f : Filter X), Disjoint (Filter.cocompact X) f ↔ ∃ K ∈ f, IsCompact K

doc: A filter is disjoint from the cocompact filter if and only if it contains a compact set.
statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] (f : Filter X), Disjoint f (Filter.cocompact X) ↔ ∃ K ∈ f, IsCompact K

∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y} {y : Y},
  Filter.Tendsto f (Filter.cocompact X) (nhds y) → Continuous f → IsCompact (insert y (Set.range f))

∀ {X : Type u} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {f : ι → X} {x : X},
  Filter.Tendsto f Filter.cofinite (nhds x) → IsCompact (insert x (Set.range f))

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {f : ℕ → X} {x : X},
  Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds x) → IsCompact (insert x (Set.range f))

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X],
  (Filter.coclosedCompact X).HasBasis (fun s => IsClosed s ∧ IsCompact s) compl

doc: A set belongs to `coclosedCompact` if and only if the closure of its complement is compact.
statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X}, s ∈ Filter.coclosedCompact X ↔ IsCompact (closure sᶜ)

doc: Complement of a set belongs to `coclosedCompact` if and only if its closure is compact.
statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X}, sᶜ ∈ Filter.coclosedCompact X ↔ IsCompact (closure s)
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], Filter.cocompact X ≤ Filter.coclosedCompact X
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X}, IsCompact s → IsClosed s → sᶜ ∈ Filter.coclosedCompact X

doc:
Sets that are contained in a compact set form a bornology. Its `cobounded` filter is
`Filter.cocompact`. See also `Bornology.relativelyCompact` the bornology of sets with compact
closure.
statement: (X : Type u) → [TopologicalSpace X] → Bornology X
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X}, Bornology.IsBounded s ↔ ∃ t, IsCompact t ∧ s ⊆ t

doc: A locally bounded function maps a compact set to a bounded set.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {Y : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Bornology Y] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s → ∀ {f : X → Y}, (∀ (x : X), ∃ t ∈ nhds x, Bornology.IsBounded (f '' t)) → Bornology.IsBounded (f '' s)

doc:
If `s` and `t` are compact sets, then the set neighborhoods filter of `s ×ˢ t`
is the product of set neighborhoods filters for `s` and `t`.

For general sets, only the `≤` inequality holds, see `nhdsSet_prod_le`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set X} {t : Set Y},
  IsCompact s → IsCompact t → nhdsSet (s ×ˢ t) = nhdsSet s ×ˢ nhdsSet t

∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set X} {f : Filter Y},
  IsCompact s → Disjoint f (Filter.cocompact Y) → nhdsSet s ×ˢ f ≤ nhdsSet (s ×ˢ Set.univ)

∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {t : Set Y} {f : Filter X},
  IsCompact t → Disjoint f (Filter.cocompact X) → f ×ˢ nhdsSet t ≤ nhdsSet (Set.univ ×ˢ t)

∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {f : Filter Y} (x : X),
  Disjoint f (Filter.cocompact Y) → nhds x ×ˢ f ≤ nhdsSet ({x} ×ˢ Set.univ)

∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {f : Filter X} (y : Y),
  Disjoint f (Filter.cocompact X) → f ×ˢ nhds y ≤ nhdsSet (Set.univ ×ˢ {y})

doc:
If `s` and `t` are compact sets and `n` is an open neighborhood of `s × t`, then there exist
open neighborhoods `u ⊇ s` and `v ⊇ t` such that `u × v ⊆ n`.

See also `IsCompact.nhdsSet_prod_eq`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s →
    ∀ {t : Set Y},
      IsCompact t → ∀ {n : Set (X × Y)}, IsOpen n → s ×ˢ t ⊆ n → ∃ u v, IsOpen u ∧ IsOpen v ∧ s ⊆ u ∧ t ⊆ v ∧ u ×ˢ v ⊆ n

doc:
A relative version of `IsCompact.nhdsSet_prod_eq`: if `s` and `t` are compact sets,
then the neighborhoods filter of `s ×ˢ t` within `s' ×ˢ t'` is the product of the neighborhoods
filters of `s` and `t` within `s'` and `t'`.

For general sets, only the `≤` inequality holds, see `nhdsSetWithin_prod_le`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {s s' : Set X} {t t' : Set Y},
  IsCompact s → IsCompact t → nhdsSetWithin (s ×ˢ t) (s' ×ˢ t') = nhdsSetWithin s s' ×ˢ nhdsSetWithin t t'

doc: A variant of `generalized_tube_lemma` in terms of `nhdsSetWithin`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {s s' : Set X},
  IsCompact s →
    ∀ {t t' : Set Y},
      IsCompact t →
        ∀ {n : Set (X × Y)},
          n ∈ nhdsSetWithin (s ×ˢ t) (s' ×ˢ t') → ∃ u ∈ nhdsSetWithin s s', ∃ v ∈ nhdsSetWithin t t', u ×ˢ v ⊆ n

doc: A variant of `generalized_tube_lemma` that only replaces the set in one direction.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {s s' : Set X},
  IsCompact s →
    ∀ {t : Set Y},
      IsCompact t → ∀ {n : Set (X × Y)}, n ∈ nhdsSetWithin (s ×ˢ t) (s' ×ˢ t) → ∃ u ∈ nhdsSetWithin s s', u ×ˢ t ⊆ n

doc: A variant of `generalized_tube_lemma` that only replaces the set in one direction.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s →
    ∀ {t t' : Set Y},
      IsCompact t → ∀ {n : Set (X × Y)}, n ∈ nhdsSetWithin (s ×ˢ t) (s ×ˢ t') → ∃ u ∈ nhdsSetWithin t t', s ×ˢ u ⊆ n
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], IsCompact Set.univ ↔ CompactSpace X
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [h : CompactSpace X], IsCompact Set.univ
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : Filter X) [f.NeBot], ∃ x, ClusterPt x f
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (F : Ultrafilter X), ↑F ≤ nhds F.lim

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (U : X → Set X),
  (∀ (x : X), U x ∈ nhds x) → ∃ t, ⋃ x ∈ t, U x = ⊤

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X],
  (∀ {ι : Type u} (t : ι → Set X), (∀ (i : ι), IsClosed (t i)) → ⋂ i, t i = ∅ → ∃ u, ⋂ i ∈ u, t i = ∅) → CompactSpace X

doc:
Given a family of closed sets `t i` in a compact space, if they satisfy the Finite Intersection
Property, then the intersection of all `t i` is nonempty.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {ι : Type v} [CompactSpace X] {t : ι → Set X},
  (∀ (i : ι), IsClosed (t i)) → (∀ (s : Finset ι), (⋂ i ∈ s, t i).Nonempty) → (⋂ i, t i).Nonempty

doc:
The `CompactSpace` version of **Alexander's subbasis theorem**. If `X` is a topological space with a
subbasis `S`, then `X` is compact if for any open cover of `X` all of whose elements belong to `S`,
there is a finite subcover.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [T : TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set (Set X)},
  T = TopologicalSpace.generateFrom S →
    (∀ P ⊆ S, ⋃₀ P = Set.univ → ∃ Q ⊆ P, Q.Finite ∧ ⋃₀ Q = Set.univ) → CompactSpace X

∀ {X : Type u} [T : TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set (Set X)},
  T = TopologicalSpace.generateFrom S →
    (∀ (ι : Type u) (U : ι → ↑S), ⋃ i, ↑(U i) = Set.univ → ∃ J, J.Finite ∧ ⋃ i ∈ J, ↑(U i) = Set.univ) → CompactSpace X

∀ {X : Type u} [T : TopologicalSpace X] (𝔅 : Set (Set X)),
  T = TopologicalSpace.generateFrom 𝔅 →
    (∀ s ∈ 𝔅, sᶜ ∈ 𝔅) → (∀ P ⊆ 𝔅, (∀ Q ⊆ P, Q.Finite → (⋂₀ Q).Nonempty) → (⋂₀ P).Nonempty) → CompactSpace X
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} [CompactSpace X], IsClosed s → IsCompact s

doc:
If a filter has a unique cluster point `y` in a compact topological space,
then the filter is less than or equal to `𝓝 y`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {l : Filter X} {y : X},
  (∀ (x : X), ClusterPt x l → x = y) → l ≤ nhds y

doc:
If `y` is a unique `MapClusterPt` for `f` along `l`
and the codomain of `f` is a compact space,
then `f` tends to `𝓝 y` along `l`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {Y : Type u_2} {l : Filter Y} {y : X} {f : Y → X},
  (∀ (x : X), MapClusterPt x l f → x = y) → Filter.Tendsto f l (nhds y)
∀ (X : Type u_2) [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [NoncompactSpace X], ¬IsCompact Set.univ
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} [NoncompactSpace X], IsCompact s → s ≠ Set.univ
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X], Filter.cocompact X = ⊥
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], (Filter.cocompact X).NeBot → NoncompactSpace X
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], (Filter.cocompact X).NeBot ↔ NoncompactSpace X
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], ¬CompactSpace X ↔ NoncompactSpace X

doc: A compact discrete space is finite.
statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [DiscreteTopology X], Finite X

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s K : Set X},
  s.Infinite → IsCompact K → s ⊆ K → ∃ x ∈ K, AccPt x (Filter.cofinite ⊓ Filter.principal s)

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s K : Set X},
  s.Infinite → IsCompact K → s ⊆ K → ∃ x ∈ K, AccPt x (Filter.principal s)

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} [CompactSpace X],
  s.Infinite → ∃ x, AccPt x (Filter.cofinite ⊓ Filter.principal s)
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} [CompactSpace X], s.Infinite → ∃ x, AccPt x (Filter.principal s)
∀ (X : Type u_2) [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [Infinite X], ∃ z, (nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ).NeBot

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {U : X → Set X},
  (∀ (x : X), U x ∈ nhds x) → ∃ t, ⋃ x ∈ t, interior (U x) = Set.univ

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {U : X → Set X},
  (∀ (x : X), U x ∈ nhds x) → ∃ t, ⋃ x ∈ t, U x = Set.univ

doc:
The comap of the cocompact filter on `Y` by a continuous function `f : X → Y` is less than or
equal to the cocompact filter on `X`.
This is a reformulation of the fact that images of compact sets are compact.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y},
  Continuous f → Filter.comap f (Filter.cocompact Y) ≤ Filter.cocompact X

doc:
If a filter is disjoint from the cocompact filter, so is its image under any continuous
function.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {g : X → Y} {f : Filter X},
  Continuous g → Disjoint f (Filter.cocompact X) → Disjoint (Filter.map g f) (Filter.cocompact Y)

∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] [CompactSpace X] {f : X → Y},
  Continuous f → IsCompact (Set.range f)

∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y},
  Continuous f → ∀ [CompactSpace X], Function.Surjective f → CompactSpace Y
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X], IsCompact (Set.diagonal X)

∀ {X : Type u} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [Nonempty ι] {V : ι → Set X},
  Directed (fun x1 x2 => x1 ⊇ x2) V → (∀ (i : ι), IsClosed (V i)) → ∀ {U : Set X}, U ∈ nhdsSet (⋂ i, V i) → ∃ i, V i ⊆ U

doc:
If `f : X → Y` is an inducing map, the image `f '' s` of a set `s` is compact
if and only if `s` is compact.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set X} {f : X → Y},
  Topology.IsInducing f → (IsCompact s ↔ IsCompact (f '' s))

doc:
If `f : X → Y` is an embedding, the image `f '' s` of a set `s` is compact
if and only if `s` is compact.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set X} {f : X → Y},
  Topology.IsEmbedding f → (IsCompact s ↔ IsCompact (f '' s))

doc: The preimage of a compact set under an inducing map is a compact set.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y},
  Topology.IsInducing f → IsClosed (Set.range f) → ∀ {K : Set Y}, IsCompact K → IsCompact (f ⁻¹' K)

∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y},
  Topology.IsInducing f → ∀ {K : Set Y}, K ⊆ Set.range f → (IsCompact (f ⁻¹' K) ↔ IsCompact K)

doc: The preimage of a compact set in the image of an inducing map is compact.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y},
  Topology.IsInducing f → ∀ {K : Set Y}, IsCompact K → K ⊆ Set.range f → IsCompact (f ⁻¹' K)

doc: The preimage of a compact set under a closed embedding is a compact set.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y},
  Topology.IsClosedEmbedding f → ∀ {K : Set Y}, IsCompact K → IsCompact (f ⁻¹' K)

doc:
A closed embedding is proper, i.e., inverse images of compact sets are contained in compacts.
Moreover, the preimage of a compact set is compact, see `IsClosedEmbedding.isCompact_preimage`.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y},
  Topology.IsClosedEmbedding f → Filter.Tendsto f (Filter.cocompact X) (Filter.cocompact Y)

doc: Sets of subtype are compact iff the image under a coercion is.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {p : X → Prop} {s : Set { x // p x }},
  IsCompact s ↔ IsCompact (Subtype.val '' s)
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X}, IsCompact s ↔ IsCompact Set.univ

doc:
An elimination theorem for empty intersections of a family of sets
in a compact subset which are closed in the compact subset
but not necessarily in the ambient space.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s →
    ∀ {ι : Type u_3} (t : ι → Set X) {I : Set ι},
      (∀ i ∈ I, IsClosed (Subtype.val ⁻¹' t i)) → Disjoint s (⋂ i ∈ I, t i) → ∃ u, Disjoint s (⋂ i ∈ u, t ↑i)
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X}, IsCompact s ↔ CompactSpace ↑s
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X}, IsCompact s → IsDiscrete s → s.Finite

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X},
  IsCompact s → s.Infinite → ∃ z ∈ s, (nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ ⊓ Filter.principal s).NeBot

∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] [NoncompactSpace X] {f : X → Y},
  Topology.IsClosedEmbedding f → NoncompactSpace Y

∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] [h : CompactSpace Y] {f : X → Y},
  Topology.IsClosedEmbedding f → CompactSpace X

∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set X} {t : Set Y},
  IsCompact s → IsCompact t → IsCompact (s ×ˢ t)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → TopologicalSpace (X i)] {s : Set ι} {t : (i : ι) → Set (X i)},
  s.Finite → (∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (t i)) → IsCompact (s.sigma t)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → TopologicalSpace (X i)] (u : Set ((i : ι) × X i)),
  IsCompact u → ∃ s t, s.Finite ∧ (∀ (i : ι), IsCompact (t i)) ∧ s.sigma t = u

doc:
The coproduct of the cocompact filters on two topological spaces is the cocompact filter on
their product.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y],
  (Filter.cocompact X).coprod (Filter.cocompact Y) = Filter.cocompact (X × Y)

∀ {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y],
  NoncompactSpace (X × Y) ↔ NoncompactSpace X ∧ Nonempty Y ∨ Nonempty X ∧ NoncompactSpace Y

doc: **Tychonoff's theorem**: product of compact sets is compact.
statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → TopologicalSpace (X i)] {s : (i : ι) → Set (X i)},
  (∀ (i : ι), IsCompact (s i)) → IsCompact {x | ∀ (i : ι), x i ∈ s i}

doc: **Tychonoff's theorem** formulated using `Set.pi`: product of compact sets is compact.
statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → TopologicalSpace (X i)] {s : (i : ι) → Set (X i)},
  (∀ (i : ι), IsCompact (s i)) → IsCompact (Set.univ.pi s)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → TopologicalSpace (X i)] {s : Set ((i : ι) → X i)},
  IsClosed s → (IsCompact s ↔ ∀ (i : ι), IsCompact (Function.eval i '' s))

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → TopologicalSpace (X i)] {s : Set ((i : ι) → X i)},
  (∃ K, IsCompact K ∧ s ⊆ K) ↔ ∀ (i : ι), ∃ Ki, IsCompact Ki ∧ s ⊆ Function.eval i ⁻¹' Ki

doc:
**Tychonoff's theorem** formulated in terms of filters: `Filter.cocompact` on an indexed product
type `Π d, X d` the `Filter.coprodᵢ` of filters `Filter.cocompact` on `X d`.
statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : ι → Type u_3} [inst : (d : ι) → TopologicalSpace (X d)],
  (Filter.coprodᵢ fun d => Filter.cocompact (X d)) = Filter.cocompact ((d : ι) → X d)

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {S : Set X},
  IsClosed S → S.Nonempty → ∃ V ⊆ S, V.Nonempty ∧ IsClosed V ∧ ∀ V' ⊆ V, V'.Nonempty → IsClosed V' → V' = V
